title_candidates: Claude Fable 5 brings Mythos power with guardrails
summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5 as the public, guarded version of its Mythos-class model, while keeping Claude Mythos 5 limited to trusted-access users.

primary_source.title: Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5
primary_source.author: Anthropic
key_facts: Claude Fable 5 is the broadly available guarded version of Anthropic's Mythos-class model.
Claude Mythos 5 uses the same underlying model but is limited to Project Glasswing and trusted-access users.
Fable 5 can fall back to Opus 4.8 for requests flagged by safeguards in sensitive domains.

prerequisites: A Claude account with Fable 5 available
One hard, non-sensitive task to test

steps.instruction: Compare the same non-sensitive hard task in Opus 4.8 and Fable 5, then check whether the added capability justifies cost and retention tradeoffs.

risk_flags: Fable 5 requires 30-day retention and is not available under zero data retention.
